title: Bridging Compressed Communication and Local Steps via Spectral Method in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23434v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of complex models across large-scale networks of edge devices while keeping data localized. However, data heterogeneity and high communication overhead remain fundamental bottlenecks. Recently, the spectral optimizer Muon has demonstrated remarkable advantages over Adam-like methods in centralized training. While recent efforts have attempted to transition Muon to FL, naive integrations into traditional architectures fail short. Crucially, existing approaches do not support the the communication compression and local steps --- the two foundational techniques of efficient FL. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel spectral FL method that utilizes both local updates and compression. We establish rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, notably eliminating the restrictive bounded heterogeneity condition. Empirical evaluation on standard image classification benc

translated_title: 在联邦学习中通过谱方法桥接压缩通信与本地步骤
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.23434v1 公告类型：new 摘要：联邦学习（FL）能够在保持数据本地化的同时，在大规模边缘设备网络上协同训练复杂模型。然而，数据异构性和高通信开销仍然是根本性的瓶颈。最近，谱优化器Muon在集中式训练中展现出了相较于Adam类方法的显著优势。尽管近期已有工作尝试将Muon迁移到联邦学习中，但将其简单地整合到传统架构中效果不佳。关键在于，现有方法不支持通信压缩和本地步骤——这两项是高效联邦学习的基础技术。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一种新颖的谱联邦学习方法，它同时利用本地更新和压缩技术。我们在温和的假设下建立了严格的收敛性保证，特别是消除了限制性的有界异构性条件。在标准图像分类基准上的实验评估（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种同时支持本地更新与通信压缩的新型谱联邦学习方法，并在无需有界异构性这一限制性假设的温和条件下，给出了严格的收敛性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel spectral federated learning method that supports both local updates and communication compression, establishing rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions while eliminating the restrictive bounded heterogeneity condition.
